The merged preparation does not complete this work, and the reviewed branch remains necessary. I found no actionable defect introduced by the patch. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `e7cd48a0aecc6fb13a5820f0314fe9b62a73cbf0` ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | The cutover has focused worker, channel, and authority coverage with no discrete defect found in source review. | | **Proof confidence** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | Not applicable: The supplied repository state identifies a member-authored PR, so the external-contributor proof gate does not apply. The PR reports Testbox runs of queue operations through the production SQLite worker, and source tests inspect final rows after plugin revocation; this review did not independently execute them. No stored-data contract changes. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Verification | Check | Result | Evidence | |---|---|---| | **Real behavior** | Not applicable | Not applicable: The supplied repository state identifies a member-authored PR, so the external-contributor proof gate does not apply. The PR reports Testbox runs of queue operations through the production SQLite worker, and source tests inspect final rows after plugin revocation; this review did not independently execute them. No stored-data contract changes. | | **Evidence reviewed** | 9 items | Current main: The fetched main queue facade still opens the state database and imports synchronous SQLite operations for operational queue work.
Broker route: The branch captures state context and dispatches queue operations through the shared state worker.
Write admission: Queue mutations execute in the worker transaction and request transaction and commit grants before returning a result. | | **Findings** | None | None. | | **Security** | None | None. | ## How this fits together Channel plugins queue inbound events before acknowledging transport delivery. The shared state database retains those events while the channel drain claims, dispatches, and completes them. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Inbound channel event] --> B[Ingress queue request] B --> C[Live plugin authority] C --> D[Shared state broker] D --> E[SQLite ingress rows] E --> F[Channel drain] F --> G[Dispatch and completion] ``` ## Before merge None.

### Review metrics | Metric | Value | Why it matters | |---|---|---| | **Production versus test growth** | production net +22; tests and support net +522 | The small production increase carries worker admission and settlement; the larger test increase covers queue and authority behavior. | ### Root-cause cluster Relationship: `canonical` Canonical: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/159073 Summary: The earlier merged kernel extraction prepares this distinct final worker cutover. Members: - `partial_overlap`: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/158928 - It extracted listing and recovery kernels but left the operational queue facade synchronous. Proposal only: this assessment does not dispatch repair, suppress jobs, mutate sibling items, close, or merge anything. ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep one broker-backed queue owner and its compatible plugin contract, then record the planned signed-SMS process-kill replay on merged main. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Yes, at source level: current main still opens the queue database and runs operational SQLite work on the calling path. This read-only review did not execute a Gateway reproduction. Is this the best way to solve the issue? Yes. Reusing the existing shared-state broker is the narrow owner cutover, and the optional listing method preserves external queue implementations. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. No stored-data contract changes. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Current main:** The fetched main queue facade still opens the state database and imports synchronous SQLite operations for operational queue work. ([`src/plugin-state/plugin-state-store.runtime.test.ts:284`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e7cd48a0aecc6fb13a5820f0314fe9b62a73cbf0/src/plugin-state/plugin-state-store.runtime.test.ts#L284), [e7cd48a0aecc](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e7cd48a0aecc6fb13a5820f0314fe9b62a73cbf0)) - **Plugin queue compatibility:** The coherent listing is optional in the queue contract, and the drain retains separate reads for external queues without that method. ([`src/channels/message/ingress-drain.ts:586`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e7cd48a0aecc6fb13a5820f0314fe9b62a73cbf0/src/channels/message/ingress-drain.ts#L586), [e7cd48a0aecc](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e7cd48a0aecc6fb13a5820f0314fe9b62a73cbf0)) - **Restart coverage:** An existing Telegram test reopens the durable queue and checks replay after restart; the PR reports running routed extension tests. The planned signed-SMS process-kill replay is separately described as post-merge work. ([`extensions/telegram/src/telegram-ingress-drain.test.ts:356`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e7cd48a0aecc6fb13a5820f0314fe9b62a73cbf0/extensions/telegram/src/telegram-ingress-drain.test.ts#L356), [e7cd48a0aecc](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e7cd48a0aecc6fb13a5820f0314fe9b62a73cbf0)) Likely related people: - **steipete:** Suggested for follow-up; no historical authorship or introduction is verified. (role: unverified routing candidate; confidence: low) - **Ayaan Zaidi:** Suggested for follow-up; no historical authorship or introduction is verified. (role: unverified routing candidate; confidence: low) ### Rating scale | Score | Internal tier | Crab rank | Meaning | |---:|:---:|---|---| | **6/6** | S | 🦀 challenger crab | Exceptional readiness | | **5/6** | A | 🦞 diamond lobster | Very strong readiness | | **4/6** | B | 🐚 platinum hermit | Good normal PR; ordinary maintainer review | | **3/6** | C | 🦐 gold shrimp | Useful, but confidence is limited | | **2/6** | D | 🦪 silver shellfish | Proof or implementation needs work | | **1/6** | F | 🧂 unranked krab | Not merge-ready | | N/A | NA | 🌊 off-meta tidepool | Rating does not apply | Overall follows the weaker of proof and patch quality. Shiny media proof means a screenshot, video, or linked artifact directly shows the changed behavior.
